claims.summary: Fallen Empires 1994-11-01, credited artist Drew Tucker.

An Island tapped to cast High Tide before the spell resolves gets no retroactive bonus. After it resolves, every subsequent Island tapped for mana provides the usual mana plus an additional {U} for the controller, including the opponent's Islands. Multiple High Tides can stack. With four basic Islands, tap the first for {U} to cast High Tide. Once it resolves, tap Island #2 and #3 for {U}{U} apiece, accumulating {U}{U}{U}{U}. Cast Turnabout for {2}{U}{U} targeting yourself and choosing lands; untap all four Islands. Tapping all four afterwards yields eight blue mana (two apiece).

Federico Dato's 1998 Pro Tour Rome High Tide archive includes Island, High Tide, Turnabout, Time Spiral, Merchant Scroll and Stroke of Genius. Wizards later described High Tide as a successful anti-Academy combo deck at that Pro Tour; this specific four-Island line remains an editorial reconstruction.
